answer_1.quote: Multilingual semantic parsing allows a single model to convert natural language utterances from multiple languages into logical forms (LFs).

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the AL methods by measuring the accuracy of the MSP, the bias of the training set, and the semantic discrepancy rate between the selected utterances and their BTs.

answer_4.quote: Two annotators manually check the percentage of the BTs which are not semantically equivalent to their original utterances.
answer_4.guideline: The percentage of back-translations (BTs) that are not semantically equivalent to their original utterances.
